Name: Voice Chat Tweaks
Author: AqueleCass
Description:
VoiceChat Tweaks
[heading]Description[/heading]
VoiceChat Tweaks is a small addon for Stardew Valley's VoiceChat mod that adds extra options for the microphone HUD and mute controls.
Customize how and when the microphone HUD appears, choose how your mute key behaves, hide the HUD while playing alone, and more.
The mod currently includes full translations for [b]English and Portuguese[/b].
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Install the original [b]VoiceChat[/b] mod.[/*]
[*]Download and extract [b]VoiceChat Tweaks[/b] into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The mod will automatically create its configuration file after the first launch.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
🎙️ Microphone HUD
Choose when the microphone icon is displayed:
[list]
[*][b]Always[/b]: Always show the microphone icon.[/*]
[*][b]Only When Talking[/b]: Show the icon only while speaking.[/*]
[*][b]Hidden[/b]: Hide the microphone icon completely.[/*]
[/list]👤 Hide When Playing Alone
Automatically hide the microphone HUD when no other players are connected.
🗣️ Talking Players
Choose whether to display the names of players who are currently speaking.
🔇 Custom Mute Key
Set a custom key to mute your microphone, or disable the key entirely.
🔄 Mute Modes
Choose between two different mute behaviors:
[list]
[*][b]Toggle[/b]: Press once to mute and press again to unmute.[/*]
[*][b]Hold to Mute[/b]: Stay muted only while holding the key.[/*]
[/list]💬 Mute Messages
Display an on-screen message whenever your microphone is muted or unmuted when using Toggle mode.
🚫 Start Muted
Start the game with your microphone muted.
[heading]Languages[/heading]
The mod currently includes full translations for:
[list]
[*]🇺🇸 [b]English[/b][/*]
[*]🇧🇷 [b]Português (Brasil)[/b][/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]VoiceChat[/b][/*]
[/list]This mod is an addon for VoiceChat and requires it to function.
Make sure the required mods are installed and updated before launching the game.
[heading]Shout Outs[/heading]
A big thank you to the creator of [b]VoiceChat[/b] for creating the original voice chat system that this mod builds upon.
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for the tools, documentation, and inspiration that make projects like this possible.
